description: The file configures the Vietnamese locale ('vi') for the Moment.js library, defining date and time formats, locale-specific parsing, and relative time expressions.

methods.name: isPM
methods.description: Determines whether the given input string indicates a PM (returns true if input matches 'ch'), used for locale-specific meridiem parsing.

methods.name: meridiem
methods.description: Returns the meridiem indicator ('sa', 'SA', 'ch', 'CH') based on the hour and formatting preferences.

methods.name: ordinal
methods.description: Returns the ordinal representation of a number, in this case simply returning the number itself.
